hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; if [ -z "$f" ]; then exit 0; fi; base=$(basename "$f"); if [[ "$base" == .env* && "$base" != ".env.example" ]]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked: only .env.example may be read or edited; other .env* files can contain secrets."}}'; fi; }

jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | { read -r cmd; if [ -z "$cmd" ]; then exit 0; fi; matches=$(printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -oE '\.env[A-Za-z0-9_.-]*'); bad=0; for m in $matches; do if [ "$m" != ".env.example" ]; then bad=1; fi; done; if [ "$bad" = "1" ]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked: Bash commands may not reference .env* files (secrets) other than .env.example."}}'; fi; }
